metadata.question: Was the number of fire detections in Pantanal, Brazil on June 11, 2024, greater than the number detected in any June from 2000 to 2023, as observed with MODIS Aqua?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location).
- Collection: MODIS/061/MYD14A1 (MODIS Aqua Thermal Anomalies & Fire Daily, FireMask band).
- Location: Pantanal ecoregion intersected with Brazil boundary using RESOLVE/ECOREGIONS/2017 and FAO/GAUL/2015.
- Dates: Single day 2024-06-11 vs. all Junes from 2000–2023.

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use FireMask classification; no cloud masking. Count pixels where FireMask indicates fire (>=7; low/nominal/high confidence). Unmask to 0 to allow 0 valid detections.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If daily collection size is 0 => C1.
- If reduceRegion returns null/NaN or total pixels = 0 => C3.
- Zero fire pixels is a valid result (not C2).
</thinking>

const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const pantanal = ee.FeatureCollection('RESOLVE/ECOREGIONS/2017')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ECO_NAME', 'Pantanal'))
      .geometry();
    const brazil = ee.FeatureCollection('FAO/GAUL/2015/level0')
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM0_NAME', 'Brazil'))
      .geometry();
    const geom = pantanal.intersection(brazil, ee.ErrorMargin(1000));

    const scale = 1000;
    const colAqua = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD14A1')
      .select(['FireMask'])
      .filterBounds(geom);

    const dayStart = '2024-06-11';
    const dayEnd = '2024-06-12';

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const colDay = colAqua.filterDate(dayStart, dayEnd);
    const getInfo = (obj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => obj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

    const daySize = await getInfo(colDay.size());
    if (daySize === 0) {
      console.log('2024-06-11 Images: 0');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const imgDay = colDay.mosaic();
    const allPixDay = await getInfo(
      imgDay
        .select('FireMask')
        .reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        })
        .get('FireMask')
    );
    if (allPixDay === null || allPixDay === 0) {
      console.log(`2024-06-11 Images: ${daySize}, Pixels: 0`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const fireBinaryDay = imgDay.select('FireMask').gte(7).rename('fire').unmask(0);
    const fireCountDay = await getInfo(
      fireBinaryDay.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: 1e9,
      }).get('fire')
    );
    if (fireCountDay === null || isNaN(fireCountDay)) {
      console.log(`2024-06-11 Images: ${daySize}, Pixels: ${allPixDay}, Fire: null`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Baseline: June (2000–2023) monthly totals using Aqua
    const years = ee.List.sequence(2000, 2023);

    const binFunc = function(img) {
      return img.select('FireMask').gte(7).rename('fire').unmask(0).toFloat();
    };

    const yearFc = ee.FeatureCollection(years.map(function(y) {
      y = ee.Number(y);
      const juneY = colAqua
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(6, 6, 'month'))
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(y, y, 'year'));
      const n = juneY.size();
      const sumImg = ee.Image(ee.Algorithms.If(n.gt(0), juneY.map(binFunc).sum(), null));
      const monthSum = ee.Algorithms.If(
        n.gt(0),
        sumImg.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9,
        }).get('fire'),
        null
      );
      return ee.Feature(null, {year: y, images: n, june_fire_count: monthSum});
    }));

    const withData = yearFc.filter(ee.Filter.notNull(['june_fire_count']));
    const yearsWithData = await getInfo(withData.size());
    if (yearsWithData === 0) {
      console.log(`2024-06-11 Images: ${daySize}, Pixels: ${allPixDay}, Fire: ${fireCountDay}`);
      console.log('June 2000–2023: 0 years with Aqua images');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    const maxFeat = ee.Feature(withData.sort('june_fire_count', false).first());
    const maxJuneCount = await getInfo(maxFeat.get('june_fire_count'));
    const maxYear = await getInfo(maxFeat.get('year'));

    if (maxJuneCount === null || isNaN(maxJuneCount)) {
      console.log(`2024-06-11 Images: ${daySize}, Pixels: ${allPixDay}, Fire: ${fireCountDay}`);
      console.log(`June 2000–2023 years with data: ${yearsWithData}, Max June Fire: null`);
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Output concise evidence
    console.log(`Aqua 2024-06-11 Images: ${daySize}, Pixels: ${allPixDay}, Fire: ${fireCountDay}`);
    console.log(`June 2000–2023 (Aqua): Years w/ images: ${yearsWithData}, Max June Fire: ${maxJuneCount} (Year: ${maxYear})`);

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const daily = Number(fireCountDay);
    const baselineMax = Number(maxJuneCount);

    if (!isFinite(daily) || !isFinite(baselineMax)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const answer = daily > baselineMax ? 'A' : 'B';
    console.log(answer);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
